# ORC Project Overview

ORC executes configuration-driven agents in ordered layers and snapshots enabled agent configuration when a run starts.

## Authority Model

Curated decisions and lessons are the default knowledge surface. Roadmaps and reviews are historical context. Raw evidence is deliberately requested only when needed.

See [[Decisions/Immutable Workflow Snapshot]], [[Lessons/Retry After Partial Execution]], and [[Roadmaps/Phase 5 Retrieval Quality]].
